home.hero_title: Empowering Women with Knowledge, Rights & Safe Guidance
home.hero_subtitle: Simple, calm, and legally accurate awareness information on rights, digital privacy, workplace safety, and verified emergency helplines.
home.core_domains_subtitle: Explore verified information across key areas of safety, law, and digital well-being.
home.verified_helplines_subtitle: Direct, toll-free national emergency lines across India.
home.in_crisis_desc: Dial the nationwide 24/7 emergency response number (112) for immediate police, medical, or disaster dispatch. Other helplines are listed for educational reference.
home.emergency_card_desc: Dial the nationwide 24/7 unified emergency response number (112) for immediate police, fire, medical, or crisis dispatch across all states and union territories.
home.emergency_112_unavailable: Emergency 112 contact is temporarily unavailable. Please dial 112 directly from any mobile or landline phone.
home.other_support_subtitle: Verified national helplines for specialized guidance, women's referral, legal aid, and online financial fraud.
home.not_emergency_service_notice: Support and guidance helplines are not emergency dispatch services. In active danger or physical threat, dial 112 immediately.
home.not_emergency_service: This is not an emergency service
home.legal_highlights_subtitle: Indian legislation and procedural frameworks provide specific protections designed to safeguard personal dignity and safety.
home.explore_all_10_desc: Explore all 10 topics covering digital safety, domestic rights, and workplace protections.
home.principles_desc: NARI-SURAKSHA does not require account creation, login, or personal incident disclosures. This platform is built solely to educate, inform, and guide.
home.feature_rights_desc: Learn about 10 foundational topics including domestic safety, stalking, image-based abuse, and free legal aid entitlements.
home.feature_what_to_do_desc: Guided, calm next-steps when encountering harassment, cyber stalking, domestic distress, or workplace discrimination.
home.feature_cyber_desc: Protections against cyberstalking, fake profiles, non-consensual imagery, financial UPI scams, and how to safely log evidence.
home.feature_workplace_desc: Understand POSH Act, Internal Committees (IC), Local Committees (LC), inquiry timelines, and anti-retaliation rules.
home.feature_laws_desc: Plain-language educational summaries of Indian legislations: PWDVA 2005, POSH Act 2013, Dowry Prohibition Act, and IT Act.
home.feature_help_desc: Verified helpline contacts, One Stop Centres (Sakhi), Legal Services Authorities (NALSA/DLSA), and NCW references.

help.page_title: Get Help: Verified Directory & Support Services
help.page_subtitle: Access national emergency response (112), district One Stop Centres (Sakhi), cyber safety guidance, and statutory legal aid clinics.
help.priority_desc: Toll-free 24/7 nationwide emergency service for immediate police, fire, or medical dispatch across all states and union territories.

whatToDo.page_subtitle: Choose a general topic to see information and options. Do not enter personal details. This guide cannot assess your situation.
whatToDo.structured_guides_subtitle: Read comprehensive stage-by-stage reference documentation for formal reporting and documentation.
whatToDo.active_danger_desc: Do not navigate lengthy articles or administrative forms if you are currently unsafe. Prioritize moving to safety and call emergency dispatch immediately.

workflow.main_concern_question: What is your main concern today?
workflow.main_concern_desc: Select an option below to view safe options and resources. Answers are held only in temporary memory and are never saved or sent to any server.
workflow.calm_unsure_note: It is completely okay to feel unsure about the level of risk. Choose the option below that feels safest to you right now without any pressure.
workflow.national_erss_desc: 24/7 toll-free all-India emergency helpline connecting to police, medical assistance, and fire rescue.
workflow.directory_desc: Women Helpline 181, Cyber Crime 1930, One Stop Centres
workflow.no_dispatch_note: NARI-SURAKSHA does not dispatch first responders or track your location. Emergency calls connect through your telecom provider directly to 112.
workflow.quick_exit_note: Use the Quick Exit button at the top of the screen at any time to instantly redirect to Google.
